# ADR 0003: UNKNOWN is a status, resolved before refunding

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Bill payments aggregator

## Context

A vend can succeed even if our call timed out; refunding then gives the customer money and the token.

## Decision

Timeouts move to UNKNOWN; a job queries biller status with backoff; only definite failures refund.

## Consequences

No double value. Some customers wait for resolution.

## Alternatives considered

Refund on timeout.
